briefing: Market is mildly risk-on today (NASDAQ +1.0%, S&P500 +0.5%), but cash on hand is only $89.29 — well below the $500 threshold needed to open a meaningful new position, so no buys are feasible despite 3 open slots. All 7 existing positions are held; none have hit the automatic -7% stop-loss or +12% profit-target thresholds, so no discretionary sells are warranted.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag happens when a portfolio holds cash that's too small to deploy into a new position, so it sits idle instead of earning returns. Today's $89 cash balance is well under the $500 minimum needed to open a new trade, so the agent held steady rather than forcing a small, poorly-sized buy. Waiting for cash to build up (e.g. via a sell or dividend) is often better than breaking position-sizing discipline.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「閒置現金拖累」(Cash Drag)是指投資組合中持有的現金太少,無法用來開立新倉位,因此只能閒置而無法產生回報。今日現金餘額僅89美元,遠低於開立新倉所需的500美元門檻,因此代理人選擇維持現有部位,而非勉強做一筆規模過小的交易。等待現金累積(例如透過賣出或股息)通常比破壞倉位規模紀律更為明智。

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted higher today with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, consistent with a mild risk-on tone across tech and growth names. No major catalyst news was available in today's feed to pin the move to a specific headline. Broad participation without extreme moves suggests steady buying rather than a sharp reaction to a single event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日股市溫和上揚,納斯達克指數升幅領先標普500指數,反映科技及成長股偏向風險偏好的氣氛。今日新聞資料中未見明顯的重大消息可解釋此走勢。市場升幅溫和且參與面廣,顯示資金持續流入而非對單一事件的劇烈反應。
